comparison.rationale: One BF16 machine epsilon in absolute and relative terms permits backend reduction-order variation without masking transpose, bias, or indexing errors.

contract.arithmetic_order: FP32 products accumulate over input_features, BF16 bias is promoted and added in FP32, then the result is cast once to BF16

purpose: Numerical parity for the Mojo Qwen2 BF16 affine linear reference path.

source_tensors.bias: deterministic synthetic BF16 values defined in generate.py
source_tensors.input: deterministic synthetic BF16 values defined in generate.py
source_tensors.weight: deterministic synthetic BF16 values in source-compatible (output_features, input_features) order

target_model.note: Synthetic tensors exercise decode, short-prefill, bias, and non-SIMD-aligned input widths; no model weights were downloaded or extracted.
